vote.question: [US-MA - U.S. Senate]: Edward Sen. Markey (D) has received $23,151,961 in career campaign contributions (with $5,985,385 this cycle)—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Do you vote to formally rebuke Edward Sen. Markey for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Edward Sen. Markey has amassed $23,151,961 in career contributions (with $5,985,385 this cycle)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Edward Sen. Markey on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $5,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $5,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
